segments.text: And lights out and away we go! Verstappen gets a fantastic start from pole position, Hamilton right behind him.
segments.speaker: Crofty

segments.text: Norris has made up a position at the start, he's now up to P3 ahead of Leclerc into turn one.
segments.speaker: Crofty

segments.text: The gap between Verstappen and Hamilton is already 0.8 seconds after the opening lap. Max is pulling away.
segments.speaker: Brundle

segments.text: Sainz has pitted from P5! An early stop, he's gone from medium tires to the hard compound.
segments.speaker: Crofty

segments.text: Safety car deployed! There's been an incident at turn 4. Looks like Perez has gone off into the barrier.
segments.speaker: Crofty

segments.text: Under the safety car now, the field bunches up. Hamilton is right on the gearbox of Verstappen.
segments.speaker: Brundle

segments.text: Green flag! Racing resumes and Verstappen gets a good restart. Hamilton has to defend from Norris behind.
segments.speaker: Crofty

segments.text: Norris has got alongside Hamilton into turn 3! Side by side, fantastic racing. Norris takes P2!
segments.speaker: Crofty

segments.text: Leclerc is now battling with Alonso for P5. The gap is under a second, DRS is enabled.
segments.speaker: Brundle

segments.text: Hamilton pits! He's come in for hard tires. A slow stop, 3.2 seconds. He'll rejoin behind Alonso.
segments.speaker: Crofty
